Q2  With neat sketch, explain the construction working of Bootstrap air- refrigeration
system.  Also  show  the  various  processes  in  T-s  diagram  with  its  component
analysis.
[5] CO1 L3

Q3  An  aircraft  refrigeration  plant  has  to handle  a  cabin  load  of  25  tonnes.  The
atmospheric temperature is 16°C. The atmospheric air is compressed to a pressure
0.96  bar  and  temperature  of  29°C  due  to  ram  action.  This  is  then  further
compressed  in  a  compressor  to  4.8  bar,  cooled  in  a  heat  exchanger to 66  °C,
expanded in a turbine to 1 bar pressure and supplied to the cabin. The air leaves
the cabin at a temperature of 26°C. The isentropic efficiencies of both compressor
and turbine are 0.9. Calculate:
(i) Mass of air circulated per minute,
(ii) COP
